people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?
translations.bsb: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: ‘Who can be compared to your greatness?
translations.kjv: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
translations.asv: Son of man, say unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude: Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
